definitions:

A census-designated place in Santa Cruz County, California.
A settlement in Wilkinson County, Georgia.

An unincorporated community in both Caribou County, Idaho and Lincoln County, Wyoming.
An unincorporated community in Franklin Township, Owen County, Indiana.
An unincorporated community in Russell County, Kentucky.
A town in Waldo County, Maine.
A township and unincorporated community therein, in Washtenaw County, Michigan.
An unincorporated community in Osage County, Missouri.
A town in Carroll County, New Hampshire. 
An unincorporated community in Frontier County, Nebraska.
A town and hamlet therein, in Cattaraugus County, New York. 
A town in Woods County, Oklahoma.
A borough in Beaver County, Pennsylvania.
An unincorporated community in Sanpete County, Utah.
A town in Forest County, Wisconsin.
A town and unincorporated community therein, in Outagamie County, Wisconsin.
A town in Sauk County, Wisconsin.
A number of other townships, listed under Freedom Township.
A census-designated place in Santa Cruz County, California.

blocks.text: Freedom is the power or right to speak, act, and change as one wants without hindrance or restraint. Freedom is often associated with liberty and autonomy in the sense of "giving oneself one's own laws".
